lv_priya_ask.text: Got a minute? Okay, thirty seconds. Vellore called. The critical care nursing course. The interview is on Thursday.
Grace has me on nights all week. If I ask her to swap, she'll look at me like I asked for a kidney. Her kidney.

choose.text: I'll talk to Grace for you.

then.text: You would? She'll make you fill a form. In triplicate. With a pencil she sharpened in 1998.

choose.text: Go on Thursday. I'll do your drug round myself.

then.text: You. Doing a drug round. Okay. I'm writing everything on the chart in capital letters.
Right. No, totally. It's only my whole career. Cool. Cool cool cool.

lv_tom_ask.text: Doctor. Small favour. Not small. Medium.
A hospital in Dubai wants a scrub nurse. Four times the money. They want a reference from a doctor who's seen me work.
My daughter got engineering in Manipal. The fees have more zeroes than my salary.

choose.text: I'll write you a glowing one.

then.text: Glowing. Like a headlamp. Thank you, Doctor. I mean it.

choose.text: An honest one. It'll still be good.

then.text: Honest is fine. Just leave out the retractor I dropped. That was one time. One.

choose.text: Don't go. Who'll scrub for Dr. Iyer?

then.text: Dr. Iyer can scrub for herself. She scares the instruments into place anyway.

lv_zoya_ask.text: Quick question. Is it normal to forget whether you ate today? Asking for a friend. The friend is me.
I've been here since six. I had a biscuit at ten. Or I dreamt the biscuit. Unclear.

choose.text: Go and eat. Now. I'll hold your bleep.

then.text: You're holding my bleep? That's the most iconic thing a senior has ever done. Okay. Bye. Eating.

choose.text: Push through. That's how we all learnt.

then.text: Cool. Character development. Love that for me.

choose.text: I'm telling Dr. Iyer you need a day off.

then.text: Snitch. A caring snitch. But a snitch.

lv_khan_ask.text: Before you say anything about the ringtone. My cousin set it, and now it's tradition. I'm not allowed to change it.
Here. A card. The nikah is on the twentieth, the reception's after. You're invited. Bring an appetite, and a gift that isn't a pressure cooker.

then.text: Good. Wear something that isn't scrubs. I've seen your other clothes. I'm worried.

choose.text: I'll try. I'm on call that week.

then.text: Everyone's on call. He's a cardiologist. He'll be on call at his own wedding.
Three kinds. My mother is competing with his mother. You're welcome.

lv_iyer_ask.text: Can you take my clinic for an hour? My mother's care home rang. She's decided the nurses are spies again.
She was a judge for thirty years. She's very good at accusing people. Less good at evidence.
lv_iyer_ask.head: tilt

then.text: Thank you. It's mostly backs and knees. If anyone asks, I'm in theatre. It's a lie, but a kind one.
Of course. I'll ring her. She'll sentence me to something.

lv_sethi_ask.text: Don't laugh. I'm sitting the super-speciality entrance. Again. Third time.
Quiz me. Anything. Ask something horrible and pretend I'm not sweating.

choose.text: Branches of the coeliac trunk. Go.

then.text: Left gastric, splenic, common hepatic. Ha. Okay, that was humiliating and helpful. Same thing, in medicine.
Charm. Yes. I'll hang a lemon and seven chillies on my admit card.

choose.text: Maybe take a break from it?

then.text: Take a break. Wow. Thank you, Mummy.
